assets.group: depth palette (palette.json) + 8 ground variants + 10 decals + 21 cliff-kit pieces + 3 emissive props + 4 clutter props + 2 cluster-example composites
assets.author: game-art
assets.technique: Canvas.js pixel matrix (fillEllipse/fillRect/fillPolygon/line/blendPixel) + the studio's 16-tile blob autotile corner-rounding algorithm (blob_autotile16.js, extracted from forest_v4_tiles.js/gen_forest_v6_pieces.js's inline copies) + forest_v4_props.js rimDarken() reused as-is. Palette: a documented HSV darken/desaturate of forest_v4_palette.js day ramps (forest_v8_depth_palette.js) plus a new cliff ramp built from the same source, and a small set of reserved fully-saturated accents (2 reused from endesga32.js, 2 new) for the emissive props only. No PixelLab generation and no third-party art referenced pixel-for-pixel.
assets.styleReference: docs/DRAKANTOS_VISUAL_STUDY.md (ADR-011 Sec.5: style/composition reference only, citing the study's own table items by number in code comments and in this tileset.json -- no pixels copied from any Drakantos screenshot or frame).
assets.license: studio-original (GS-003 fan game, ADR-007/ADR-009) -- no third-party art referenced pixel-for-pixel. Third-party style references (Drakantos) informed the palette/depth/cluster direction only, per ADR-010/ADR-011 Secao 5, not these specific pixels.
